text:
emily: uploaded a quick figma for a compact latency card that combines p95 + heatmap + sampling toggle. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/compact-latency-card — focus is on making the collapsed state still show the p95 and a hint that sampling is active
kevin: looked — nice. main concern: when collapsed the p95 text drops to 10px and loses contrast. can we keep the metric visible without breaking layout?
anya: agree on contrast. also keyboard focus disappears when you switch to compact. I tried tabbing and the sampling toggle is skipped.
emily: yeah, that was my prototype shortcut. proposal: keep p95 as a bold badge on the left, heatmap becomes tiny sparkline to the right, sampling as a small pill with indicator dot.
marcus: sgtm. small nit on copy: the sampling pill currently says "sampling: on" — maybe shorten to "sampled" or use an icon + tooltip to reduce visual weight.
kevin: +1 on icon + tooltip. Also for screen readers we need an aria-label that says the sampling rate and whether it's enabled. e.g. `aria-label=\"Sampling: on, 10% rate\"`
a11y-bot: Accessibility check: ensure color contrast for p95 >= 4.5:1 in compact mode; make sampling pill focusable with visible focus ring; add role=\"switch\" and aria-checked to the toggle.
emily: thanks — can someone mock the focus state? I can push an updated figma by EOD.
anya: also think about animations: collapsing currently animates width which shifts the p95 number horizontally — that makes it hard to scan in long lists. consider fading/morph instead of shift.
marcus: good catch. for large tables we want stable layout to reduce visual jitter. a crossfade on the heatmap and a fixed container for metrics should help.
kevin: UX question: do we show p95 value for routes with <100 samples? right now it shows `—` which is fine, but maybe show a tooltip "insufficient samples" on hover.
emily: yeah tooltip copy: "p95 unavailable (samples < 100). Enable sampling or increase time window." feedback?
anya: OK but I prefer shorter: "p95 unavailable — < 100 samples".
kevin: plus we should surface last-refresh time in tiny text so people know it's not stale data.
emily: noted. I'll update figma: keep p95 badge, tiny sparkline heatmap, sampling pill with icon+tooltip, keyboard focus ring, aria attrs, and crossfade animation.
marcus: one last thing — on mobile the compact card might stack; ensure the sampling pill doesn't wrap under the p95 badge.
emily: will check breakpoints. thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
a11y-bot: Automated reminder: add keyboard-only screenshot tests for compact card after design update.
